verdict.rationale: Bruno ships an official CLI (bru) that runs collections headlessly, generates JSON/JUnit/HTML reports, integrates with CI/CD pipelines, and even provides official Docker images for CI use without needing Node/npm on host — verified hands-on via probe that the CLI installs and runs headlessly. missing for 10: no independent third-party report of a real CI pipeline run, only first-party docs plus a keyless hands-on probe.
